mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message ( sender_id, sender_name, sender_nickname, sender_avatar, receiver_id, receiver_name, receiver_nickname, receiver_avatar, content, is_read, is_deleted, hidden_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{senderId}, #{senderName}, #{senderNickname}, #{senderAvatar}, #{receiverId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverNickname}, #{receiverAvatar}, #{content}, #{isRead}, #{isDeleted}, #{hiddenBy}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_message WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND ((sender_id = #{userId1} AND receiver_id = #{userId2}) OR (sender_id = #{userId2} AND receiver_id = #{userId1})) AND (hidden_by IS NULL OR hidden_by NOT LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{currentUserId}, ',%')) ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT m.id, m.sender_id, m.sender_name, m.sender_nickname, m.sender_avatar, m.receiver_id, m.receiver_name, m.receiver_nickname, m.receiver_avatar, m.content, m.is_read, m.is_deleted, m.create_time FROM chat_message m INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(m2.id) as max_id FROM chat_message m2 WHERE m2.is_deleted = 0 AND (m2.sender_id = #{userId} OR m2.receiver_id = #{userId}) AND (m2.hidden_by IS NULL OR m2.hidden_by NOT LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{userId}, ',%')) GROUP BY LEAST(m2.sender_id, m2.receiver_id), GREATEST(m2.sender_id, m2.receiver_id) ) latest ON m.id = latest.max_id ORDER BY m.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM chat_message WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND ((sender_id = #{otherUserId} AND receiver_id = #{currentUserId}) OR (sender_id = #{currentUserId} AND receiver_id = #{otherUserId})) AND (hidden_by IS NULL OR hidden_by NOT LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{currentUserId}, ',%')) ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET is_read = 1 WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND sender_id = #{senderId} AND is_read = 0
UPDATE chat_message SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND (sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0 AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND sender_id = #{senderId} AND is_read = 0 AND is_deleted = 0
